display_policy: Highest-similarity region only if score >= threshold; otherwise No Matching Object without a box.
localization: Full-frame plus overlapping 512px tiles; training foreground/background patch matching and local dark-object contrast refinement; not a trained detector
score: 100 * max cosine similarity of crop CLS+mean patch feature to ship-crop reference prototypes
limitations: Uncalibrated crop threshold; candidate identity unverified; low-contrast or bright vessels may be missed. Development samples, not independent accuracy test.
